title: SO(3)-Equivariant Learning on CAD Boundary Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.05449v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning on boundary representations (B-reps) requires robustness to the pose of a part, since CAD models are not stored in a canonical orientation. Existing B-rep networks either operate on world-frame coordinates and normals, and thus degrade under rotation, or encode each face in a local reference frame. Local frames yield invariance, but reduce inter-face messages to scalars and discard the relative orientation of adjacent faces. We propose SO3brep, an SO(3)-equivariant graph neural network on the B-rep face-adjacency graph. Node features are computed in local frames and mapped into a shared frame by Wigner D-matrices. Clebsch-Gordan tensor products couple these features with the directions between adjacent faces, so that relative orientation is preserved throughout message passing and the output remains SE(3)-invariant. translated_title: 面向CAD边界表示的SO(3)等变学习
translated_abstract: 在边界表示（B-rep）上进行学习需要对零件姿态具有鲁棒性，因为CAD模型并非以规范朝向存储。现有的B-rep网络要么在世界坐标系下使用坐标和法向量，从而在旋转下性能退化；要么在局部参考系中对每个面进行编码。局部参考系虽然能带来不变性，但会把面间消息传递简化为标量，从而丢弃相邻面之间的相对朝向信息。我们提出SO3brep，一种作用于B-rep面邻接图的SO(3)等变图神经网络。节点特征在局部参考系中计算，并通过Wigner D矩阵映射到共享坐标系中。Clebsch-Gordan张量积将这些特征与相邻面之间的方向耦合起来，使相对朝向信息在整个消息传递过程中得以保留，同时输出保持SE(3)不变性。在三个面分割基准和两个分类基准上（测试零件经过随机旋转），SO3brep取得……（摘要在此截断）
tldr: SO3brep是一种作用于B-rep面邻接图的SO(3)等变图神经网络，通过Wigner D矩阵和Clebsch-Gordan张量积在消息传递中保留相邻面间的相对朝向，从而对随机旋转的CAD模型实现鲁棒的面分割与分类。
en_tdlr: SO3brep is an SO(3)-equivariant graph neural network on B-rep face-adjacency graphs that preserves inter-face relative orientation during message passing via Wigner D-matrices and Clebsch-Gordan tensor products, enabling robust face segmentation and classification on randomly rotated CAD models.
